description: This file defines the BudgetService class, which provides methods for CRUD operations on budget data via an API client. The class includes methods to list, create, update, and remove budgets, utilizing HTTP requests to specific endpoints.

classes.name: BudgetService
classes.description: Service class for CRUD operations on budgets, interfacing with an API via ApiClient.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of budgets, optionally filtered by month.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new budget using provided BudgetModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget identified by id with new data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a budget identified by id.
